plain: Deliberately trying to make a model misbehave so the problems are found before release.
eli5: Pretending to be the sneaky kid on purpose, to find out how the rules could be broken and fix them.
technical: Adversarial testing of a model, by people or by other models (Perez et al. 2022), to find inputs that elicit harmful, unsafe or off-policy behaviour; it serves safety as well as security, and because models are probabilistic its findings are reported as attack success rates rather than single exploits; a red-team prompt is one written for this purpose.
